correctness.rationale: Source result follows standard Fredholm index-zero/kernel reduction for analytic polynomial harmonic-Bergman Toeplitz operators, separating 0,1,2,3 roots inside disk. Independently recomputed h(z,w)=a+z²+(3/2)zw+(3/2)w² two-root determinant = -(3/4)(x-y)²(-2a+2x²+9xy+2y²), and confluent determinant at a=-3alpha² = -57alpha²/4. One-root h(alpha,alpha)=a+4alpha²=0 yields lambda=-3alpha³, exterior quadratic roots (-1±sqrt13)alpha/2 and threshold tau=2(7+sqrt13)/9. Exact equality endpoints belong to boundary curve, not isolated points. Original rigorous argument includes all complex a/repeated roots and explicit eigenvector; Fredholm premise is cited rather than re-proved. No false claim identified.
